node.statement: By the definition of D_* and the exact W.r_reset formula supplied by lem-maincb-witness-arithmetic, D_*>=1 and D_*>=D_i for i=0,1,2,3, while W.r_reset<=min{e_0,e_1,e_2,e_3,epsilon_max^cb,delta_max^cb/D_*,e_it/(D_*+1),epsilon_unit,delta_unit/max{1,K_floor},a_unit/((1+K_disp)*D_*),[2*(1+K_disp)*D_*]^{-1}}. Hence every 0<=t<=W.r_reset obeys all these provider thresholds, including D_*t<=delta_max^cb and (D_*+1)t<=e_it.
